decisions.reason: The adherence/compliance meaning fits rules and workplace compliance. The dwelling/stay sense is not selected, and the old claim about passive constructions is not approved.
The reclining meaning is framed as ancient dining and the other adjective is botanical. Neither establishes an appropriate Fitness alternative for supine; retain hidden.
The source explains photochemical effects of electromagnetic radiation in the definition itself. Keep the already-reviewed Academic restriction, not a general NGSL replacement for solar.
Plant spikes and stings do not fit the existing Fitness needle anchor. A botanical meaning is not evidence for an exercise-vocabulary connection.
The exact source qualifier concerns microorganisms thriving in oxygen, not aerobic exercise. The previous Fitness relevance objection remains unresolved.
The self-contained buoyant-aircraft definition fits the transport balloon anchor. It covers balloons and dirigibles without limiting the general term to military or tethered use.
The proposed Business conglomerate connection explicitly concerns volcanic rock, not companies. Do not substitute the geological or urban-development senses into that business relationship.
The sourced farmer/gardener definition is directly relevant to the farmer anchor. It does not require scientific expertise; the old expertise comparison and separate adviser meaning are not promoted.
Agriculture treated as an industrial economic sector fits both economics and business. Do not inherit the narrower unverified claim that the word excludes growing crops.
The only meaning is military airborne force. The general Business aviation anchor does not establish a military learning context, so the specialist extension stays hidden.
Radio-frequency waves in wireless communication fit communications technology. Preserve plural-only usage and do not teach the old imprecise definition as empty space carrying signals.
Anatomical processes, botanical parts and ancient Roman rooms are specialist senses not justified by the ordinary NGSL wing anchor. Retain uncertain relevance hidden.
Using an algorithm is a complete manner definition relevant to computing and workplace procedures. It is not interchangeable with all electronic operations; no such connection is approved.
Preserve the existing archive: extinct-mammal taxonomy is unrelated to the Academic/Business multi-prefix anchor. No source or scope evidence resolves that mismatch.

The sourced flowing-water sediment definition is self-contained and appropriate for Academic earth science. Restrict the technical term to Academic instead of a general substitute for every NGSL deposit.

The definition explicitly explains mixture, merger or consolidation and fits the existing combination/business-merger anchors. Do not select the mercury-alloy sense or extend it through Fitness synthesis.
The cached radical definition needs clearer chemical nomenclature and identity evidence. It must not be presented as interchangeable with amino, especially in Fitness vocabulary.
The radical derived from primary or secondary amines is a precise Academic chemistry term. Preserve compound-use labels and exclude the unrelated Fitness amino extension.
The electric-current definition includes charge per unit time and amperes, making the measured-current meaning explicit for the current anchor. No unrelated current senses are included.

The amphoteric-electrolyte definition is specialist chemistry, while the only proposed anchor is Business buffer. The topic mismatch remains and the terse definition adds an unexplained technical term.
